targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) AS total_cost FROM cost_records WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")

WITH anchor AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', MAX("timestamp")) AS day FROM cost_records), current_period AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0)::double precision AS cost FROM cost_records, anchor WHERE "timestamp" >= anchor.day AND "timestamp" < anchor.day + INTERVAL '1 day'), previous_period AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0)::double precision AS cost FROM cost_records, anchor WHERE "timestamp" >= anchor.day - INTERVAL '1 day' AND "timestamp" < anchor.day) SELECT current_period.cost - previous_period.cost AS delta FROM current_period, previous_period

WITH daily AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', "timestamp") AS bucket, cloud_provider, COALESCE(account_id, '') AS account_id, service, COALESCE(tags->>'oci_compartment_name', tags->>'oci_compartment_id', 'unknown') AS compartment, COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0)::double precision AS total_cost FROM cost_records WHERE "timestamp" >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - INTERVAL '7 days' AND "timestamp" < $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5), series AS (SELECT bucket, cloud_provider, account_id, service, compartment, total_cost, AVG(total_cost) OVER w AS baseline, STDDEV_POP(total_cost) OVER w AS stddev FROM daily WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY cloud_provider, account_id, service, compartment ORDER BY bucket ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)) SELECT COUNT(*) AS anomaly_candidates FROM series WHERE bucket >= $__timeFrom() AND bucket < $__timeTo() AND baseline IS NOT NULL AND (ABS(CASE WHEN COALESCE(stddev, 0) > 0 THEN (total_cost - baseline) / stddev ELSE 0 END) >= 2 OR ABS(CASE WHEN COALESCE(baseline, 0) > 0 THEN ((total_cost - baseline) / baseline) * 100 ELSE 0 END) >= 30 OR ABS(total_cost - baseline) >= baseline * 0.25)
SELECT (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM MAX("timestamp")) * 1000)::bigint AS latest_cost_record FROM cost_records
SELECT (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM MAX(processed_at)) * 1000)::bigint AS latest_ingestion FROM processed_reports WHERE status = 'processed'
SELECT time_bucket('1 day', "timestamp") AS "time", SUM(cost) AS value FROM cost_records WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT service AS metric, SUM(cost) AS value FROM cost_records WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") GROUP BY service ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT COALESCE(tags->>'oci_compartment_name', tags->>'oci_compartment_id', 'unknown') AS metric, SUM(cost) AS value FROM cost_records WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Top Daily Increases by Service and Compartment

targets.rawSql: WITH anchor AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', MAX("timestamp")) AS current_start FROM cost_records), current_period AS (SELECT service, COALESCE(tags->>'oci_compartment_name', tags->>'oci_compartment_id', 'unknown') AS compartment, SUM(cost)::double precision AS current_cost FROM cost_records, anchor WHERE "timestamp" >= anchor.current_start AND "timestamp" < anchor.current_start + INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY 1, 2), previous_period AS (SELECT service, COALESCE(tags->>'oci_compartment_name', tags->>'oci_compartment_id', 'unknown') AS compartment, SUM(cost)::double precision AS previous_cost FROM cost_records, anchor WHERE "timestamp" >= anchor.current_start - INTERVAL '1 day' AND "timestamp" < anchor.current_start GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT COALESCE(c.service, p.service) AS service, COALESCE(c.compartment, p.compartment) AS compartment, COALESCE(c.current_cost, 0) AS current_cost, COALESCE(p.previous_cost, 0) AS previous_cost, COALESCE(c.current_cost, 0) - COALESCE(p.previous_cost, 0) AS delta, CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.previous_cost, 0) > 0 THEN ((COALESCE(c.current_cost, 0) - p.previous_cost) / p.previous_cost) * 100 WHEN COALESCE(c.current_cost, 0) > 0 THEN 100 ELSE 0 END AS pct_change FROM current_period c FULL OUTER JOIN previous_period p ON c.service = p.service AND c.compartment = p.compartment WHERE COALESCE(c.current_cost, 0) - COALESCE(p.previous_cost, 0) > 0 ORDER BY delta DESC LIMIT 15

WITH anchor AS (SELECT date_trunc('week', MAX("timestamp")) - INTERVAL '7 days' AS current_start FROM cost_records), current_period AS (SELECT service, COALESCE(tags->>'oci_compartment_name', tags->>'oci_compartment_id', 'unknown') AS compartment, SUM(cost)::double precision AS current_cost FROM cost_records, anchor WHERE "timestamp" >= anchor.current_start AND "timestamp" < anchor.current_start + INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY 1, 2), previous_period AS (SELECT service, COALESCE(tags->>'oci_compartment_name', tags->>'oci_compartment_id', 'unknown') AS compartment, SUM(cost)::double precision AS previous_cost FROM cost_records, anchor WHERE "timestamp" >= anchor.current_start - INTERVAL '7 days' AND "timestamp" < anchor.current_start GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT COALESCE(c.service, p.service) AS service, COALESCE(c.compartment, p.compartment) AS compartment, COALESCE(c.current_cost, 0) AS last_week_cost, COALESCE(p.previous_cost, 0) AS previous_week_cost, COALESCE(c.current_cost, 0) - COALESCE(p.previous_cost, 0) AS delta, CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.previous_cost, 0) > 0 THEN ((COALESCE(c.current_cost, 0) - p.previous_cost) / p.previous_cost) * 100 WHEN COALESCE(c.current_cost, 0) > 0 THEN 100 ELSE 0 END AS pct_change FROM current_period c FULL OUTER JOIN previous_period p ON c.service = p.service AND c.compartment = p.compartment ORDER BY ABS(COALESCE(c.current_cost, 0) - COALESCE(p.previous_cost, 0)) DESC LIMIT 15

WITH anchor AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', MAX("timestamp")) - INTERVAL '1 month' AS current_start FROM cost_records), current_period AS (SELECT service, COALESCE(tags->>'oci_compartment_name', tags->>'oci_compartment_id', 'unknown') AS compartment, SUM(cost)::double precision AS current_cost FROM cost_records, anchor WHERE "timestamp" >= anchor.current_start AND "timestamp" < anchor.current_start + INTERVAL '1 month' GROUP BY 1, 2), previous_period AS (SELECT service, COALESCE(tags->>'oci_compartment_name', tags->>'oci_compartment_id', 'unknown') AS compartment, SUM(cost)::double precision AS previous_cost FROM cost_records, anchor WHERE "timestamp" >= anchor.current_start - INTERVAL '1 month' AND "timestamp" < anchor.current_start GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT COALESCE(c.service, p.service) AS service, COALESCE(c.compartment, p.compartment) AS compartment, COALESCE(c.current_cost, 0) AS last_month_cost, COALESCE(p.previous_cost, 0) AS previous_month_cost, COALESCE(c.current_cost, 0) - COALESCE(p.previous_cost, 0) AS delta, CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.previous_cost, 0) > 0 THEN ((COALESCE(c.current_cost, 0) - p.previous_cost) / p.previous_cost) * 100 WHEN COALESCE(c.current_cost, 0) > 0 THEN 100 ELSE 0 END AS pct_change FROM current_period c FULL OUTER JOIN previous_period p ON c.service = p.service AND c.compartment = p.compartment ORDER BY ABS(COALESCE(c.current_cost, 0) - COALESCE(p.previous_cost, 0)) DESC LIMIT 15

WITH daily AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', "timestamp") AS day, service, COALESCE(tags->>'oci_compartment_name', tags->>'oci_compartment_id', 'unknown') AS compartment, COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0)::double precision AS actual FROM cost_records WHERE "timestamp" >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - INTERVAL '7 days' AND "timestamp" < $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1, 2, 3), series AS (SELECT day, service, compartment, actual, AVG(actual) OVER w AS baseline, STDDEV_POP(actual) OVER w AS stddev FROM daily WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY service, compartment ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)) SELECT day, service, compartment, actual, baseline, actual - baseline AS delta, CASE WHEN COALESCE(baseline, 0) > 0 THEN ((actual - baseline) / baseline) * 100 ELSE 0 END AS pct_change FROM series WHERE day >= $__timeFrom() AND day < $__timeTo() AND baseline IS NOT NULL AND (ABS(CASE WHEN COALESCE(stddev, 0) > 0 THEN (actual - baseline) / stddev ELSE 0 END) >= 2 OR ABS(CASE WHEN COALESCE(baseline, 0) > 0 THEN ((actual - baseline) / baseline) * 100 ELSE 0 END) >= 30 OR ABS(actual - baseline) >= baseline * 0.25) ORDER BY ABS(actual - baseline) DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT provider, COUNT(*) AS processed_reports, SUM(record_count) AS reported_records, MAX(last_modified) AS latest_report_modified, MAX(processed_at) AS latest_processed_at FROM processed_reports WHERE status = 'processed' GROUP BY provider ORDER BY provider
